summary: This panel discussion explores the importance of minhagim within the Sephardic community, focusing on the traditions of the Yamim Nora'im. The speakers discuss the origins and proper timing of Selihoot, as well as the history and symbolism behind the Simanim eaten on the night of Rosh Hashanah.
questions: Is it better to say Selihoot after sunrise or not at all if one cannot wake up early?
What is the historical origin of the Selihoot custom?
Why are there so many different lists of Simanim?
What is the significance of the Simanim eaten on Rosh Hashanah?
